title: OCI digest (content-addressable identifier)
summary: An OCI (Open Container Initiative) digest is a content-addressable identifier: algorithm:hex (e.g., sha256:abc123...). Used to identify container images, layers, and manifests immutably.

notes: hex-digest: lowercase hex string of the specified length (64 for sha256, 128 for sha512).
Digests are computed over the canonical JSON of the manifest or the tar+gzip of the layer.
Content-addressable: the digest uniquely identifies the content.
